title: Chinese-origin Type 59 tank explodes during exercise in Bangladesh, 2 killed: Report

An investigation has been ordered by the Bangladesh Army to determine the exact cause of this accident.

Property owners are taking down PG signboards to avoid scrutiny, and volunteers are stepping in to help with rescue operations and to provide essential supplies to those affected.

title: 5 ‘lost’ baby orangutans found in Odisha forest

Forest officials suspect a transoceanic trafficking network smuggled the young apes into India. Villagers alerted the forest department after spotting the orangutans dangling from tree branches. The animals were safely secured without the use of tranquilizers by forest personnel. A Wildlife Crime Control Bureau team is investigating the origin of these exotic animals.
